# seb.now

> An open link feed: posts from followed YouTube channels, Mastodon accounts, web and event feeds, and Hacker News, tagged with the topics they're about and the entities they mention, ranked by readers' votes.

Agents read the feed through the MCP server rather than this page. Every post, topic, entity, kind and sort order has its own page.

## Agents

- [MCP server](/mcp): read-only tools: get_feed, search_links, list_topics, get_links_by_topic, get_link, list_topic_proposals
- [Signed-in MCP server](/mcp/user): OAuth; ranks the feed by your votes, and can vote, propose topics and suggest a link's topic

### The MCP server over plain HTTP

No MCP client is needed: `/mcp` is stateless Streamable HTTP, so every request is one JSON-RPC 2.0 message in a POST, answered with plain JSON. There are no sessions and no `initialize` handshake to do first (GET and DELETE answer 405). Send `Content-Type: application/json` and `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`.

List the tools and their input schemas:

```sh
curl -s https://seb.now/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```

Call one:

```sh
curl -s https://seb.now/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_feed","arguments":{"limit":10}}}'
```

`/mcp/user` takes the same messages with an OAuth bearer token; without one it answers 401 with a `WWW-Authenticate` header pointing at its protected-resource metadata, where the OAuth flow starts.

## Browse

- [Latest](/o/latest): every post, newest first
- [Top](/o/top): most upvoted
- [Discussed](/o/discussed): most replied to
- [Sources](/k/entity.source): every followed channel, account and feed
